title: "I don't deal combat damage" is not enforced in combat resolution
expected: Card def packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/ezreal-dashing.ts:49-56 grants keyword "NoCombatDamage" via static grant-keyword. In the engine, calculateSideMight (packages/riftbound-engine/src/combat/combat-resolver.ts:114-121) only skips units with unit.dealsNoCombatDamage. That flag is set in exactly two places: resolve-full-combat.ts:230-234 (stunned units) and combat-resolver.ts:141-143 (Vilemaw PreventWeakerEnemyCombatDamage threshold). A repo-wide grep for "NoCombatDamage" in riftbound-engine/src and apps/riftbound-app finds no other reference — the keyword lands in CombatUnit.keywords but nothing reads it, so Ezreal contributes his full 3 Might to combat damage.
observed: In both cases the opposing Mech was killed by combat (sent to trash alongside Ezreal), i.e. Ezreal dealt his 3 Might as combat damage. meta.grantedKeywords contains {keyword:"NoCombatDamage",duration:"static"} but packages/riftbound-engine/src/combat/combat-resolver.ts only honours CombatUnit.dealsNoCombatDamage, which is set solely by the Vilemaw PreventWeakerEnemyCombatDamage path — nothing maps the NoCombatDamage keyword onto it.
